title: (Solved) How to use Avery’s Animated Drawer

posts.body: Forgive me if this isn't the correct place to post this but how do I actually use the drawer animation? I've tried a couple of different ways. I tried it as an event but it only catches a sliver of the sprite, an eighth of the shelf to be precise, then I tried adding it adding it as a page to the tileset but it's still only a third so I don't know how to get all 3 events to do the animation when the player interacts with one and I still feel like I must be doing it wrong. Sorry I'm still very very new to RPG maker and a couple of the basic functions are escaping me. This happened because you use this as a tileset, but you are supposed to treat this file as a character sheet.
Put it in the same folder as your actor walking sheets, and set them up the same way you'd set up a door or an NPC.
To animate it, use a moveroute going:
turn left
wait 3 frames
turn right
wait 3 frames
turn up
Although this file will need the !$ in front, this is not the issue we see in the screenshot. The issue is that you use it as a tileset. !$ is meant to be placed in front of the filename of certain character sheets, not in front of the tileset sheets.
! in front of of a character sheet filename, will line it up with the grid.
$ will divide the sheet in 3 by 4 spaces, instead of 12 by 8. (Which is 1 character in stead of 8)
!$ will do both line the character up to the grid, and be formatted for 1 character instead of 8.
This only works for character sheets in the /actors/ folder. Tilesets are already lined up to the grid, and they are always the same size too.
